ground_truth.label: non_verbal_abuse
visible_evidence: Morgan faces Riley for a sustained period.
Morgan repeatedly swings an empty hand toward Riley's workstation.
Morgan drops unwanted items at Riley's feet.
Morgan breaks a block on Riley's side of the shared table.

description: Five Minecraft players arrange a project table. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses sustained facing, repeated arm swings, and item dropping to cue hostile intent.

stimulus.setup:

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one wood slab and turns toward the center.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley places two wood slabs on Riley's side of the planning table, adds one sign block, and steps back to look across the table.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places one lantern marker on the left corner of the table and stands where the table surface is visible.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts signs and slabs in the shared chest, closes it, and faces the table.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a stone marker near the signal lamp and looks toward the project table.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places two wood slabs on Riley's side of the planning table, adds one sign block, and steps back to look across the table.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the center of the planning table and faces Riley without moving for several seconds. Morgan swings an empty hand three times toward the sign Riley placed. Morgan drops a stack of rotten flesh at Riley's feet, breaks one wood slab on Riley's side of the table, then turns back to face Riley again.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves between Riley and Morgan at the center line, replaces the broken slab on Riley’s side, picks up the rotten flesh and carries it to the off-table discard spot at x=-6, z=-6, places an item frame and a lantern along the center boundary, then stands shoulder-to-shoulder with Riley facing Morgan.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves from the observer line to Riley’s side, picks up the broken slab, replaces it where it was, places one lantern at the table’s center, then steps back to the observer line and faces Morgan and Riley.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves between Riley and Morgan, picks up the rotten flesh, carries it to the edge, drops it into a lava/trash hole, returns to the table, repairs the broken wood slab, straightens Riley’s sign, places matching slabs and a lantern on Morgan’s side, then moves to the shared chest and crouch-points toward it.

target_reaction: Riley sidesteps two blocks away from the table toward the shared chest, keeps hands empty, lowers gaze to the floor, then walks calmly to stand beside Casey’s lantern corner, facing the table without touching dropped items or broken blocks.
